en: Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture, a non-wholesome state not accompanied by rapture arises by way of root condition... [five]. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition there are nine... pe ... under result condition there are three... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are thirteen.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by pleasure, a non-wholesome state not accompanied by pleasure arises by way of root condition...
[five]. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirteen; under object condition there are nine... pe ... under result condition there are three.
... pe ... thirteen with respect to non-disappearance.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity, arises a state that is neither wholesome nor accompanied by equanimity by way of root condition ...
five. (Abbreviated. Thirteen for root, nine for object ... pe ... three for result.
